baseURL: API base URL (OpenAI compatible, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1)
extraBodyDesc: Use it to disable thinking. DeepSeek / Zhipu: {"thinking":{"type":"disabled"}}; Qwen: {"enable_thinking":false}; leave empty for providers that reject unknown fields; Gemini 3.x Flash: {"reasoning_effort":"minimal"} (3.8 Flash supports "low" at minimum); Gemini 2.5 Flash: {"reasoning_effort":"none"}. Gemini counts thinking tokens in max_tokens, so add "max_tokens":512 here to override the default 80
systemPromptDesc: Writing mode: the caret is at the end of a paragraph; only the preceding text is read and the next sentence is predicted. Saving it empty restores the default. The default follows the SiYuan interface language (Chinese / English).
userTemplateDesc: Variables: {{title}} document title, {{before}} preceding text, {{current}} current paragraph before the caret. When the title is empty, lines whose only variable is {{title}} are removed; {{current}} is appended automatically if missing.
errNoContent: Ghost Writer: the model returned no text (only reasoning, or the output was cut off). Disable thinking in "Extra request body" or add a larger "max_tokens" there
errExtraBody: Ghost Writer: the extra request body must be a JSON object, e.g. {"thinking":{"type":"disabled"}}
errBaseURL: Ghost Writer: the API base URL must start with http:// or https://
errBadResponse: Ghost Writer: the response is not valid JSON, check the API base URL: {detail}
errTimeout: Ghost Writer: request timed out ({seconds} s)
docMode: Ghost Writer: mode for this document
docModeCycle: Ghost Writer: cycle mode for this document (off → writing → revision)
docModeSet: Ghost Writer: this document is now in "{mode}"
reviseSystemPromptDesc: Revision mode: the caret may be mid-paragraph; text before and after it is read and one sentence to insert at the caret is generated. Saving it empty restores the default. The default follows the SiYuan interface language (Chinese / English).
reviseUserTemplateDesc: Variables: {{title}} document title, {{before}} preceding text, {{current}} current paragraph before the caret, {{currentAfter}} current paragraph after the caret, {{after}} following text. Lines whose only variable is {{title}} are removed when the title is empty; {{current}} is appended automatically if missing.
mobileClauseAccept: Mobile: tapping the ghost text accepts only up to the tapped clause
mobileClauseAcceptDesc: When on, tapping a spot in the ghost text accepts it up to the end of that clause and keeps the rest as a suggestion. When off, a tap accepts the whole sentence. The Accept button above the keyboard always accepts the whole sentence.
errContinueAtEnd: Ghost Writer: in Writing mode, Continue only works at the end of a paragraph. Move the caret to the end, or switch to Revision mode.
